people.name: Bathsheba
people.line: Wife of Uriah, later married David and bore Solomon.

translations.web: Bathsheba bowed, and showed respect to the king. The king said, “What would you like?”
translations.bsb: And Bathsheba bowed down in homage to the king, who asked, “What is your desire?”
translations.kjv: And Bathsheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?
translations.asv: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?
